About Us

About Brighton Flooring Solutions

Brighton Flooring Solutions focuses on practical, well-finished flooring, waterproofing, painting and building rehabilitation work. We plan each job around the surface, the way the space is used, and the finish it needs — so homes, offices and industrial spaces stay protected, durable and easy to maintain.

  • Waterproofing for roofs, terraces and walls
  • Industrial epoxy flooring for demanding spaces
  • Interior & exterior painting with careful preparation
  • Building repair, restoration and maintenance
